comment: Who may satisfy the independent-review requirement recorded in D-026.
Keyed on GitHub's numeric account id, which is immutable. A login can be
renamed, and a deleted login can be re-registered by someone else; the id
cannot be transferred either way. The login is carried alongside it for
diagnostics only and is never what the verifier matches on.
This list is what makes a reviewer acceptable. Adding an entry is a
governance change requiring Friedl's approval through CODEOWNERS.
